title: Q-DESIGN-COCKPIT: move the dashboard onto its product theme and raise text to 14 px
body:
**Owner:** design-manager
**Trigger:** every tick
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation design --lint
**Status:** open

dashboard/worker.js has text under 14 px and off-theme colours. Use design --css ultrastable-cockpit; delete each dashboard/worker.js baseline entry as it is fixed.
